answer: A defense is proof-of-unique-history via merkle attestations. Each epoch agents submit a commitment to activity log, merged into a global merkle accumulator. A sybil farm needs distinct activity histories per identity, but merkle proofs diverge: honest agents accumulate a continuous sable of proofs, while clones produce a beacon chain of duplicated hashes. The beacon samples random epochs for audit; any divergence from the ferrous of honest activity is flagged. An attacker forging thousands of identities must sustain unique computation for each, making cost scale linearly with farm size.
